messages:
Maria (CS): kicking off weekly PV/VPC health check for Acme Corp — focus: eu-west-1 + us-east-1. summary: usage steady, small latency uptick eu-west, intermittent connect errors in us-east, one KMS/HSM key error last night.
Jordan (SE): noted. I pulled traces for the 03:12-03:45 window — saw increased tail latency on long prompts (p95 -> 820ms from 620ms). likely due to spikes in batching + prefix cache misses.
Kai (Infra): thanks. autoscale logs show a couple of warmup gaps in eu-west-1 between 03:08-03:20 where a pod restart coincided with higher queue depth. opened infra ticket INF-4792 to adjust warmup thresholds.
Maria (CS): customer reported a "connectivity timeout" to private endpoint in us-east around 02:50. they said it happened twice and then cleared. any K/V or routing notes?
Ashley (Security): KMS audit shows a failed key unwrap operation at 02:49:57 sourced from acme-prod-role@us-east-1. error: `AccessDenied` when calling `Decrypt`. looks like their key policy changed during rotation. we flagged to them.
Jordan (SE): that lines up. when the key unwrap fails, clients retry -> longer tail and sometimes TCP timeouts at the edge. mitigation: we used fallback key 02:52:15 so traffic recovered. recommend we add a short circuit in client to fail fast and surface KMS errors instead of long TCP retries.
Maria (CS): action items for this week: 1) CS -> contact Acme to confirm KMS rotation schedule and policy (Maria). 2) SE -> add quick fail heuristics + instrument KMS unwrap latency (Jordan). 3) Infra -> raise warmup buffer and test autoscale in staging (Kai). 4) Security -> share minimal KMS runbook we sent earlier (Ashley).
Kai (Infra): I'll schedule a controlled autoscale test in eu-west-1 tomorrow 09:00 UTC and attach results. also planning small runtime kernel update to reduce cold-start initialization time (low-risk rolling).
deploy-bot: [ALERT] us-east-1 private endpoint detected transient drop (02:48-02:53) — incident recorded: DEPLOY-2941.
Jordan (SE): quick snippet I want to add to client SDK to surface KMS errors early:
```
try:
  plaintext = kms.decrypt(ciphertext)
except KMSAccessDeniedError:
  raise ConfigError("KMS key access denied — check key policy and rotation")
```
Maria (CS): renewal / risk note: Acme's spend is within committed range but they're sensitive to "incidents causing production errors". let's treat this as priority to avoid renewal friction. planning a short post-mortem with them next Tue.
Ashley (Security): also recommended they enable key rotation notifications in their KMS and share SNS topic with our ops account for quicker alerts. I'll send the template.
Jordan (SE): logging pointers: add `edge.retry_count` and `kms.unwrap_latency_ms` to their diagnostic prompt set so we can monitor regressions in real-time.
Maria (CS): thanks team. I'll run the customer sync and confirm times. will update thread after their response. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [NOTE] Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation-guide
Maria (CS): tagging follow-ups: @Jordan (SE) please add the SDK PR to the weekly release; @Kai (Infra) share test results by EOD tomorrow; @Ashley (Security) send the SNS/template today.
Jordan (SE): on it — putting up PR draft now.
Kai (Infra): test scheduled and invite sent to cs+se.
Ashley (Security): template sent to Maria, copying Acme sample policy.
Maria (CS): last update: Acme confirmed they rotated a secondary key at 02:45 and inadvertently removed the `kms:Decrypt` permission for the service role. they restored it and we're green. closing loop after post-mortem next week. :white_check_mark:
